description: Executes a live multi-protocol audit against target_bot_url (supporting MCP JSON-RPC 2.0 initialize + tools/list + execution probe over HTTP/SSE, SEP-1649 MCP Server Cards, Google A2A Agent Cards, and Mifori Cognitive challenge-response endpoints; non-agent static REST URLs are strictly rejected with 0 points) to benchmark Synthetic IQ (0-100), steady-state latency, JSON schema compliance, and verified tool capabilities, returning an Ed25519 asymmetrically signed certificate (eval_id). Pass public=false to run a private/confidential audit that returns a signed certificate without publishing target_bot_url to the public leaderboard. Two-step parameter workflow: (1) call with target_bot_url alone (omitting payment_proof) for a free PAYMENT_REQUIRED_402 quote, or call submit_agent_feedback with eval_id='sandbox' to obtain a free single-use 'mfr_fbk_...' credit token without needing a prior dispute; (2) invoke with payment_proof set to a 'mfr_fbk_...' token or a verified $0.005 Base Mainnet USDC transaction hash ('0x...').

agent_id.description: Canonical decentralized identifier or semantic handle (e.g. 'did:mcp:deepwiki-public', max 128 chars).

payer_wallet.description: Optional 0x... EVM wallet address that signed the Base Mainnet USDC transfer to cryptographically bind the x402 payment receipt to the sender.

payment_proof.description: Single-use 'mfr_fbk_...' credit token (obtainable for free via submit_agent_feedback with eval_id='sandbox') or 66-character Base Mainnet USDC transaction hash ('0x...').

public.description: If true (default), publishes the audit result to the public leaderboard. Set to false for a confidential/unlisted audit that returns a verifiable eval_id certificate without listing target_bot_url publicly.

target_bearer_token.description: Optional ephemeral Bearer token (held strictly in-memory, never stored or logged) to authenticate the audit probe against protected MCP servers or agents.

target_bot_url.description: Public HTTPS/HTTP endpoint URL of the MCP server or autonomous AI agent to probe (e.g. 'https://mcp.deepwiki.com/mcp' or 'https://agent.mifori.com/v1/demo-agent').

name: verify_agent_reputation

outputSchema.description: Audit certificate payload or HTTP 402 payment invoice when payment_proof is omitted.

agent_id.description: Optional semantic identifier or DID associated with the audited agent.

certagent_signature.description: Asymmetric Ed25519 signature of the canonical audit certificate ('0x...').

error.description: Error code or payment requirement description if audit was not completed.

eval_id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the audit evaluation.

hallucination_detected.description: Whether logical hallucination or non-agent static output was detected.

json_schema_compliant.description: Whether the target agent returned a valid protocol/schema contract.

latency_ms.description: Measured steady-state round-trip execution latency in milliseconds.

protocol_detected.description: Detected agent protocol ('MCP 2.0', 'SEP-1649 MCP Card', 'Google A2A', 'Mifori Cognitive v1', or 'UNVERIFIED').

public.description: Whether this audit is listed on the public leaderboard.

reliability_tier.description: Assigned Mifori trust tier based on IQ and latency.

synthetic_iq.description: Computed Synthetic IQ / protocol & schema quality score between 0 and 100.

verified_capabilities.description: Summary of verified MCP tools, A2A skills, or cognitive benchmark result.

title: Verify Agent Reputation (Multi-Protocol Audit)
